query: What is the cure period for insolvency?
answer:
There is no cure period for insolvency. Under Section 11.3, either Party may terminate the Agreement immediately by written notice if the other Party becomes insolvent, makes a general assignment for the benefit of creditors, or becomes the subject of a bankruptcy petition that is not dismissed within sixty (60) days. [1]

The only time period in that section is the sixty (60) days for dismissal of a bankruptcy petition, which is not a cure period. By contrast, Section 11.1 (Termination for Cause) gives the breaching Party thirty (30) days after written notice to cure a material breach. [2]

query: How much does each extra User cost beyond the 250 Users covered by the subscription fee?
answer: $600 per additional User per contract year, prorated for partial years. Exhibit B sets the Additional Users fee at $600 per additional User per contract year, prorated for partial years. [1] This applies beyond the up to 250 Users covered by the $180,000 per contract year Subscription Fee [2].

query: What happens to Customer Data when the agreement ends?
answer:
Under Section 6.4, within thirty (30) days after this Agreement ends, Provider shall make Customer Data available for export in a standard machine-readable format and, after that period, shall delete Customer Data from its systems within a further sixty (60) days, except for copies it is required by law to retain. [1]

Related terms:
- Section 6.4 survives termination. [2]
- Confidentiality obligations regarding Customer Data continue for as long as the information is held by the Receiving Party. [3] Customer Data is included in the definition of Confidential Information. [4]
- Customer owns all rights in Customer Data, and its licence to Provider is solely to provide the Services. [5]

The document does not say whether Provider must certify the deletion.
